AI Notes.value: Amsterdam-based post-signature design collective, founded by Dutch designer Roosje Klap, launched July 2014. Comprises around 16 members (15 designers + 1 social scientist) from various disciplines, cultures and nationalities, collaborating in shifting constellations. Works across commissioned client projects, self-initiated work and open-form workshops. Disciplines span graphic design, print (risography, silkscreen, offset), critical/speculative practice, and exhibition design. Email routes through Roosje Klap's studio (designdisplacement@roosjeklap.nl). Website currently shows a placeholder; Instagram (@designdisplacementgroup) has 15 posts, 426 followers; activity appears to have peaked around 2014-2016. No LinkedIn page found. Work Status set to Studio as it is a collective entity, not an individual freelancer or employed person.
